title.narrative: EU-UN Support to the States in Central Asia for their Citizens Returned from Conflict Zones - Component I - Phase II

description.narrative:
1. Children and their mothers/caregivers repatriated from conflict zones benefit from child and human rights-based, age and gender-sensitive support for recovery and reintegration into society.
  2. National and local capacities are strengthened to meet the needs of returned children and their families throughout the reintegration and recovery process
  3. Practices, lessons and approaches are shared across the region and coordinated amongst UN agencies, EU institutions and practitioners supporting reintegration and recovery, and opportunities for sub-regional learning and cooperation exist.
